name: @tpmjs/tools-x
description: Post to X (Twitter) as yourself: tweets with media, threads, replies, delete, read mentions and search — OAuth 1.0a user context

env.name: X_API_KEY
env.description: X app API key (consumer key); TWITTER_API_KEY is accepted as an alias

env.name: X_API_SECRET
env.description: X app API secret; TWITTER_API_SECRET alias

env.name: X_ACCESS_SECRET
env.description: User access token secret; TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET alias

tools.name: tweet
tools.description: Post a tweet, optionally as a reply or quote, with up to 4 images attached from URLs.

tools.name: tweetThread
tools.description: Post a thread: each text becomes a reply to the previous tweet.

tools.name: deleteTweet
tools.description: Delete one of your tweets by id.

tools.name: getTweet
tools.description: Fetch a tweet by id with author, metrics and referenced tweets.

tools.name: myMentions
tools.description: Read recent tweets that mention the authenticated account.

tools.name: searchTweets
tools.description: Search recent tweets (last 7 days) with the X search syntax.

tools.name: xWhoAmI
tools.description: Show which X account the configured credentials belong to — use it to verify setup.
